clue.text: Spirit trapped before it gets beaten

parts.note: kettled means penned in by police, trapped in the past
rum is a spirit

explanation.surface: Some liquor has been caught and is about to be beaten up.
explanation.walkthrough: KETTLED is British slang for crowds penned in by police lines; the pieces come in answer order, so the rum is written after.
explanation.definitionFit: A drum played in an orchestra is struck with sticks, so it is the thing that gets beaten.

clue.text: German song involving a tenor turned up in chart

indicators.note: in a down clue turned up means the letters are read from bottom to top
involving means the song wraps round the other letters

parts.note: a lied is a German art song

explanation.surface: A German song featuring a tenor climbed the charts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involving' puts AT inside LIED, making LIATED, and 'turned up' reads it backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To detail is to list point by point, much as to chart is to set out item by item.

clue.text: No going back with article by patient man at work

indicators.note: going back means the word is read in reverse

parts.note: taken as written before turning
the is the definite article
Job of the Bible is proverbial for patience

explanation.surface: Someone refuses to retreat, with a story about a long-suffering man at work.
explanation.definitionFit: Being on the job is an idiom for being busy working.

clue.text: Light cake that's eaten cold

indicators.note: the cake has eaten the other letter, swallowing it inside

parts.note: a scone is a small cake
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on a tap

explanation.surface: A light cake that is eaten cold.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads 'Light cake' as a feather-light bake; 'Light' is the definition, and C sits inside SCONE.
explanation.definitionFit: A sconce is a wall bracket holding a candle or lamp, a kind of light fitting.

clue.text: Stream left New York, returning in one of its boroughs

parts.note: a brook is a small stream

indicators.note: returning means these letters are read backwards

explanation.surface: Someone leaves a creek in New York to return to one of the city's districts.
explanation.definitionFit: Brooklyn is one of the five administrative districts of New York City.

clue.text: Preventing core emission

indicators.note: the core of a word is its central letters, here four of them

explanation.surface: Stopping a nuclear core from releasing radiation.
explanation.definitionFit: A vent is an outlet or discharge, the letting out of gas or feelings.

clue.text: Electronic instrument lacking mains lead in it

indicators.note: lacking means a letter is taken out of the instrument

parts.note: the theremin is an electronic instrument played without touch

indicators.note: the lead of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: An electronic instrument without its mains lead plugged in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mains lead' is the first letter of mains, which 'lacking' removes from THEREMIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Therein is a formal word meaning inside that thing.

clue.text: Mad rant by old writer associated with timeless pop is a downer

indicators.note: mad means the letters are scrambled

parts.note: a quill was an old writing pen

indicators.note: timeless means T, for time, is dropped

parts.note: Tizer is a British fizzy soft drink, or pop

explanation.surface: An angry tirade from an old author associated with eternal pop music is depressing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mad' turns RANT into TRAN; 'timeless' drops T (time) from TIZER, leaving IZER. Pop here is a fizzy drink, not music.
explanation.definitionFit: A downer is slang for a sedative drug that calms the user.

clue.text: Present-day Romeo in pickle with new temptation rearing its head

indicators.note: in means the Romeo letter goes inside the pickle word

parts.note: to cure meat is to preserve it, to pickle it
R is Romeo in the NATO alphabet

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A modern Romeo in a fix faces new temptation.
explanation.walkthrough: R goes into CURE to make CURRE.
explanation.definitionFit: Current things belong to the present time, contemporary.

clue.text: Valuables found here in search trustee organised?

indicators.note: organised means the letters are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: Searching through a trustee's affairs for treasure.
explanation.definitionFit: A chest holding treasure is where valuables are kept.

clue.text: Russian city where one may get fleeced

definitions.meaning: a city on the Volga delta
the curly fleece of young lambs from that region bears the city's name

explanation.definitionFit: The city lends its name to the curled lambskin fleece, so both senses share one word.

clue.text: Extravagant and atrocious act losing a grand

indicators.note: losing means these letters are removed

parts.note: an outrage is an atrocity
G is the abbreviation for grand, a thousand

explanation.surface: An extravagant atrocity loses someone a thousand pounds.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing A and G from OUTRAGE leaves the word.
explanation.definitionFit: Outre is French-derived for bizarre or beyond the bounds of convention.

clue.text: Most of queue lines to the right of crush

indicators.note: to the right of means the lines piece is placed after
most of means only the leading part of the word is used

parts.note: L is an abbreviation for line, doubled for lines

explanation.surface: Most of a queue lined up to crush.
explanation.walkthrough: Only QUE, the first three letters of queue, are used.
explanation.definitionFit: To quell a rebellion is to crush or suppress it.

clue.text: 'Little Woman' makes internet reports on radio for man in street

parts.note: Jo March is a heroine of Little Women

indicators.note: on radio means the next piece sounds like the words

parts.note: e-blogs, reports posted on the internet

explanation.surface: A diminutive woman writes online posts read out on air.
explanation.walkthrough: Joe Bloggs is the British name for an average person, the American John Doe.
explanation.definitionFit: Joe Bloggs stands for the ordinary person, the man in the street.

clue.text: Environment-friendly Kindle gets go-ahead

parts.note: green means ecologically sound
to kindle a fire is to light it

explanation.surface: An eco-friendly e-reader gets approval.
explanation.walkthrough: Kindle looks like the e-reader brand, but it is the verb to set alight.
explanation.definitionFit: A green signal means permission to proceed.

clue.text: Brain he addled is on the mend

indicators.note: addled means muddled, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A man with a confused brain is recovering.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone in a rehabilitation clinic is recovering from addiction.

clue.text: Her mobile primarily has call-back locked

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: primarily means the first letter is taken
back means the word is read in reverse

parts.note: to cite is to call or summon, as before a court

explanation.surface: Her mobile phone has its callback function locked.
explanation.definitionFit: Hermetic means airtight, sealed shut.

clue.text: Ballerina's partner sure about pursuing level of proficiency

indicators.note: pursuing means coming after the other piece

parts.note: a dan is a grade of skill in martial arts such as judo

indicators.note: about means the letters are moved around

explanation.surface: A ballerina's partner is confident about his skill level.
explanation.definitionFit: A danseur is a male ballet dancer, who partners a ballerina.

clue.text: Threshold where dripping may go on?

definitions.meaning: the step at a house's entrance
a thick slice of bread, on which beef fat is spread

explanation.definitionFit: The step at a door is a threshold, and a thick slab of bread shares the name.

clue.text: Bubbly creature's game, self-contained — and old

parts.note: a lamb is a young creature
RU is rugby union
s.c. is the abbreviation for self-contained, as in flat adverts

explanation.surface: A fizzy creature's play is independent and dated.
explanation.walkthrough: Lambrusco is a sparkling Italian red wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Bubbly is slang for sparkling wine, and this Italian red sparkles.

clue.text: No end of dexterity required with winter transport

indicators.note: no end of means the last letter is cut off

parts.note: sleight is skill or dexterity, as in sleight of hand

explanation.surface: Endless skill is needed for winter travel.
explanation.definitionFit: A sledge pulled over snow carries people in winter.

clue.text: Returned cloudy vermouth containing no mixer

indicators.note: returned means the whole run is read backwards

parts.note: C is the weather-map symbol for cloudy

indicators.note: containing means the vermouth word holds the next letters

parts.note: It is Italian vermouth, as in gin and it
taken as written

explanation.surface: A cloudy vermouth that has no mixer is sent back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Returned' reads CINOT backwards; It for Italian vermouth is an old bar term, as in gin and it.
explanation.definitionFit: Tonic water is a mixer for spirits, as in gin and tonic.

clue.text: Cheap marble's dull

parts.note: a taw is a large shooting marble
dry means boring or dull

explanation.surface: A cheap marble is dull.
explanation.definitionFit: Tawdry means showy but cheap and of poor quality.

clue.text: Ball seen rarely these days traps West Indian opener prompting expression of delight

indicators.note: traps means the name holds the other letters inside

parts.note: Zoe Ball, a British broadcaster no longer often on screen

indicators.note: the opener of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A ball game, rarely played, traps a West Indian batsman to cheers.
explanation.walkthrough: Zoe Ball is a British TV and radio presenter; W and I go inside ZOE.
explanation.definitionFit: Zowie is an exclamation of surprise or delight.

clue.text: Police No 1 was first that features Sting

indicators.note: first means the was piece comes before the other

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: number one of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: The Police's number one featured the singer Sting.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface evokes The Police, Sting's band; the insect is the thing with a sting.
explanation.definitionFit: This insect carries a sting in its tail.

clue.text: Previously lost Whistler's Tate's fourth

indicators.note: lost means the letters wander from their order

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

indicators.note: the fourth letter of the gallery name is taken

explanation.surface: A Whistler painting went missing from the fourth Tate gallery.
explanation.definitionFit: Erstwhile means former, of an earlier time.

clue.text: Due to be carved as ham may be

definitions.meaning: a joint of meat is left to stand before carving
a ham actor out of work

explanation.definitionFit: Meat stands before carving, and an idle actor between jobs is likewise said to be so.

clue.text: Hearing the outcome of people talking about you?

definitions.meaning: the range within which sound is heard

definitions.text: the outcome of people talking about you?
definitions.meaning: folklore says your ears burn when others gossip about you

explanation.definitionFit: Within range of the ear is within hearing, and burning ears come from gossip.
